This includes developing foundational pieces on the technical underpinnings of AI and its use and implications by and for government [(2019[8];](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_726fd39d_5a7a4205e9) [[9])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_932780bc_5a7a4205e9); targeted analysis on specific countries [(2022[10];](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_1f334543_5a7a4205e9) [2024[11];](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_609808d6_5a7a4205e9) [[12])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_421c1244_5a7a4205e9); surfacing government innovation trends, which often involve AI;3 and establishing a preliminary framework for AI in government [(2024[13])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_26324bc2_5a7a4205e9). If governments and other AI actors are successful in seizing AI’s benefits while mitigating its risks, AI experts and researchers envision a future in which AI contributes to scientific and medical breakthroughs, such as discovering new cancer treatments; catalyses productivity growth from a 1-7% rise in global gross domestic product (GDP) by 2033 to a 10-fold increase in the decades to come; eliminates poverty and reduces inequality; and helps address weather-related impacts and natural disasters [(OECD, 2024[14])](/en/publications/governing-with-artificial-intelligence_795de142-en/full-report/how-artificial-intelligence-is-accelerating-the-digital-government-journey_d9552dc7.html#Kappa_3f4e3dfb_5a7a4205e9).
